description: Surfaces which lesson pattern_keys have been most active recently, so you can see what keeps biting you. Filters the project's lessons to those updated within the last N days, groups them by pattern_key (keyless lessons get a synthetic '(no-key: <id>)' bucket), sums frequency, counts lessons, and tracks the latest update plus the set of types per group. Returns JSON { window_days, total_recent_lessons, top_patterns[{pattern_key,total_frequency,lesson_count,sample_title,latest_update,latest_ms,types[]}], insight }, sorted by total_frequency descending. Read-only; no writes. Use it at session start or during a retro to decide what to reinforce or refactor, and to spot a recurring pattern_key before it grows further. It complements amplify_context_load (raw rows) and amplify_suggest_pattern_key (key reuse); a hot pattern here is a strong hint to keep using its existing key. Example: amplify_recent_patterns({ project: 'chimera-prime', days: 7, limit: 10 }) → top_patterns[0] = { pattern_key: 'verify-before-disagreeing', total_frequency: 12, lesson_count: 4, ... }.

days.description: Optional. Look-back window in days (positive; coerced to an integer). Lessons whose updated_at (or created_at) falls within this window are included. Default 7.

limit.description: Optional. Max number of pattern groups to return (positive integer, capped at 50). Default 10.

project.description: Optional. Restrict to this project. Omit to use the default (empty-project) pool.

name: amplify_recent_patterns
